name: Aizal Blue dress
description2: The entire hem and train are richly decorated with soft pastel 3D floral petals, each accented with a glowing pearl center. Fully lined with a soft underlayer to ensure a smooth and comfortable fit, this gown is made to create an unforgettable fairy tale entrance.

specs.fabric: Organza with hand-embellished pearl upper body and 3D flower petals
specs.fit: Off-shoulder upper body with pearl straps, waist ruffle, and trailing skirt

description: A majestic sky-blue royal ballgown crafted with an off-the-shoulder neckline, delicate pearl shoulder straps, and a heavily embellished pearl upper body. A sculpted, wavy peplum ruffle sits at the waist, leading into a grand, flared organza skirt that extends into an exquisite sweeping floor train.
